notes.albums: Nine albums: retros (39), fan version (21), windbreakers jackets and hoodies (9), full zip windbreakers (2), full zip (1), half zip (4), training set (3), kids set (3), player version (18).
notes.multiPhotoGarments: Six garments carry more than one photograph. p299 is the front and p302 the back of the red anthem jacket; p303 and p304 are the same grey tech fleece tracksuit on two backdrops; p317 is a close-up of the embroidery on p318; p273 and p286 are the mint third shirt with the Spotify roundel and with the wordmark; p277 and p281 are the same zigzag shirt, one photographed with cup badges on the sleeve. Fronts and full-garment shots lead.
notes.seasonReading: Sponsor pins the era: Kappa to 1997, unicef 2006-2011, Qatar Foundation 2011-2013, Qatar Airways 2013-2017, Rakuten 2017-2022, Spotify 2022 onward. Within the Spotify years the goalkeeper shirts, pre-match shirts and special editions cannot be pinned to a season from the garment, so those titles carry a colour rather than a year and are marked seasonConfidence unknown.
notes.dedupe: Eight photographs were caught by dHash against the live catalogue; four more by eye against a contact sheet of all 17 live Barcelona listings (p269 the 2016/17 purple away, p284 the 2024/25 black away, p292 the 2025/26 graded home, p333 the 2026/27 purple away player). p275 is the FAN version of that same 2026/27 away and is listed as new.
notes.clientNote: The live 2025/26 Third Jersey is the TURQUOISE gradient shirt. The turquoise halved shirts in this batch (p285, p315, p327, p328) are a different kit and are titled by colour.
